lineage: fidelity probe p02_tables, 2026-09-24 (promoted by WP-G G-2, 2026-09-25; named tables-cells, plan 16 #17 - A's wp1/tables-rich keeps its name)
notes: Finding F1 (docs/engine/fidelity/01-FINDINGS.md): everything that is not text inside a cell used to be dropped,
row and row-group backgrounds with it. This is the probe that showed it: a dense 7 x 6 table whose header colour
sits on the <tr> (thead tr), zebra fills on tbody tr:nth-child(even), a highlighted tr.hl, number badges,
status pills, progress bars, emoji flags and a description block in the country cell; and a 4 x 2 side table
with a coloured label column, a color-mix() cell and an inline <svg> icon. The HTML is the probe's but for one
line: the heading has width:872px, to layout-06's title zone's right edge (see flexgrid's notes: the probe's shrink-to-fit
bold title overhung by 2 px through the test masters' manifest/theme mismatch, which is not this family's subject).
Counts follow the tables package's cell partition (10-WPA-tables.md 4.5) and master brief 11 as amended by B.
Cell text is inside the table element and is not counted in kinds.text; only what leaves a cell is.
table 2: the <table>s are native tables (a:tbl), 7 x 6 and 4 x 2.
Table 1 fills (10-WPA 4.3, row / row-group fills composited under the cells): row 0 0B2545 from thead tr, rows
2, 4, 6 F3F5F9 from the zebra rule, row 3 DCF5E6 from tr.hl, rows 1 and 5 none. Cell (r, 1) holds 2 paragraphs
(the .cty line with its flag, then the .desc block); cell (r, 3) holds the number ('92') - the bar under it is
paint only; cells (r, 0) and (r, 5) are empty because their chips left them.
Table 2 fills: column 0 EAF2FF (td.lbl, with a 4 px 0B5CAD left border as a cell border, not a shape); (1, 1)
DDF0E6 = color-mix(in srgb, #1E9E5A 15%, white) = 0.15 x 1E9E5A + 0.85 x FFFFFF; (3, 1) F3F5F9 - the zebra rule
also matches the implicit tbody of this table, and row 3 is even; (1, 0) and (1, 1) are even too but carry
their own backgrounds, which win.
text 13 = title 1 + 12 chip texts: the six .num badges and six .pill spans are inline boxes with a fill (4.5
rule 3, a chip): each is a shape plus a text box placed over the native table (Peter #4), and its text leaves
the cell. The badge digits are centred (text-align:center in an 18 px box).
shape 25 = 12 chip shapes (6 badge circles 0B5CAD 18 x 18, 6 pills 1E9E5A / F59E0B / D64545) + 12 bar shapes
(per row the .bar track E1E6EE and its <i> fill 0B5CAD: filled blocks that own no text, 4.5 rule 6, decoration
overlays; the <i> widths are 92/78/74/70/55/61 % of the 68.8 px track) + 1 ellipse (the inline <svg> icon in
table 2 (3, 1), 4.5 rule 2: an overlay expanded by the SVG extractor, 12 x 12, 1E9E5A; the text after it stays
in the cell).
The flags (regional-indicator pairs) have no glyph in Calibri: the browser draws them with a fallback face and
the emitter says so per line ('characters with no glyph in the measured face', 6 emit warnings, not IR
diagnostics). PptxRender draws them as boxes and PowerPoint as letter pairs (findings 2) - a renderer/platform
gap that this family's gate ceiling carries.

gateMaxPx2 458 = 382 px2 masked, measured 2026-09-25 on main 4ab1be8 (fidelity-w2 + X, plan 16 #22) + G-2, references rendered in Calibri / Calibri Light; two runs, identical, + 20 % (Peter #16, plan 11). Of it:

all 382 px2 are the title - test-16x9's manifest/theme mismatch (G-1 open item 14, D item 17): the browser draws the 700 heading in Calibri Light with synthetic bold, advances unchanged (Edge, measured in weights' notes), while PptxRender, like PowerPoint, draws the file's +mj-lt b=1 through the theme part's major font as Calibri Bold, ~3 % wider and heavier. The two tables, their row fills, chips, bars and icon are
clean at the gate's settings (blur 2, delta E 8, 60 px2 minimum area); the 11 px flags' PptxRender boxes stay under the minimum area.

gateMaxPx2 459 = max(measured x 1.2, measured + 60) over the measured 382 px2 masked non-chart area on fidelity-w3 (2314d7f), 2026-09-25 (plan §11; Peter #16: measured + 20 %, with the 60 px2 per-slide noise tolerance as the floor). A regression guard, not a target.
